name: 💜[RELEASE!] MonsterVerze💜
desc:
💜Welcome to MonsterVerze💜

Where your second life... is your afterlife.

Enter a world where the dead serve way more than the living! Style yourself hauntingly, created wholesome friendships, remember MonsterVerze is your all-access pass to the afterlife you've always dreamed of. Customize your look, discover unknown secrets, ride eerie trains to mysterious locations, and most importantly-survive in style.
👻 See you soon, witches. Weve been dying to meet you.
—
💌 How to Play:

🚛 Step 1. Don't die (seriously).
⭐️ Step 2. If you do mess up Step 1... refer to Step 4. And also, listen to Skella. She's kind of your afterlife advisor.
🚂 Step 3. Catch the train. Always. Miss it, and
you might miss your fate.
✨ Step 4. Your second life is your afterlife-so make the most of it.
